pull.title: MINOR: Close leaked resources in tests
pull.body:
Follow-up to #23604. Several tests create a client, metrics, or log
manager that the cleanup method never closes, either because a local
variable shadows the field closed in `@AfterEach`, or because the field
set up in `@BeforeEach` is reassigned without closing the old instance.
This fixes the same pattern in `KafkaConsumerTest`, `MetricsTest`,
`LogManagerTest`, and `WorkerTaskTest`.

Generated-by: Claude Opus 5.5

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>

review_comments.body: Could you initialize it directly and then remove setup and the null check in tearDown?

commit.message:
MINOR: Close the KafkaConsumer created in KafkaConsumerTest tests

Fourteen tests declared a local KafkaConsumer named consumer, which shadows
the field that cleanup() closes, and never closed it. Each leaked consumer
kept its JMX reporter and metrics registered, and with the CONSUMER group
protocol also its background thread.

Assign the field instead, like the other tests in this class, so cleanup()
closes the consumer.

MINOR: Close leaked Metrics instances in MetricsTest

testConcurrentReadUpdate replaced the setUp Metrics (JMX reporter and
sensor expiry thread) without closing it. testRemoveChildSensor created a
local Metrics that was never closed; it now uses the field closed in tearDown.

MINOR: Shut down the setUp LogManager before reassigning it in LogManagerTest

Six tests reassigned the logManager field without shutting down the instance
started in setUp: testCreateLogOnTargetedLogDirectory, testLoadLogsSkipRemoteIndexCache,
testLoadLogRenameLogThatShouldBeStray, testMetricsAreRemovedWhenMovingCurrentToFutureLog,
testLoadDirectoryIds and testReplaceCurrentWithFutureLogDoesNotCloseSourceLog.
tearDown only shut down the new one, leaking the old one's metrics and open log files.

MINOR: Stop the ConnectMetrics created in WorkerTaskTest tests

Two tests created a local MockConnectMetrics that shadowed the field and was never stopped, leaking its registered metrics and MBeans.
Reuse the field created in setup, which tearDown already stops, and declare it as MockConnectMetrics so the tests can use its helpers.
MINOR: Initialize ConnectMetrics directly in WorkerTaskTest
